item.title: Abandoned furniture dumped onto coupland place road and pavement, 27th July
item.description:
There is a sofa and several other large items that have been dumped, taking up valuable parking space on our road. Parking is already extremely limited, and these dumped items have made the situation even worse. This issue has been reported multiple times by residents over the telephone, but nothing has been done. A council officer also attended the area and spoke to residents, yet the waste still remains. It is particularly frustrating that parking enforcement officers have been issuing parking tickets when residents are struggling to find anywhere to park because the dumped items are occupying spaces. It feels unfair that there is time to issue fines, but not to remove illegally dumped waste that is affecting the whole street. Please can this be dealt with as a matter of urgency.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Coupland Place, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
